description: Refund an order, in full or in part. This moves real money back to the customer. Polar: POST /v1/refunds/.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's minor unit (cents). Omit to refund the full order.

comment.description: An internal note about the refund.

reason.description: Why the refund is being issued.

revoke_benefits.description: Also revoke the benefits the order granted. Defaults to false.

name: polar_create_refund
title: Refund an order
